svg.aria-label: Schematic of the design pipeline: active-site geometry (theozyme), scaffold generation with RFdiffusion2 and RFdiffusion3, sequence design with ProteinMPNN and LigandMPNN, structure validation with AlphaFold2 and AlphaFold3, and experimental characterization by activity assays. Illustration only: the noise cloud is not a model output, the overlaid traces are not an AlphaFold result, and the assay wells are not measurements.
